STA Scheduled Tasks - Reference

Every recurring STA / AI-system automation, what it does, and when it runs  ·  Adam Baker  ·  Updated 2026-07-06

INTERNAL · ADMIN REFERENCE

What this is: the catalog of scheduled tasks that keep STA's work products and AI system running - daily, weekly, and monthly jobs that fire on their own in Cowork.

Scope: STA work automations and AI-system maintenance only. Adam's personal jobs (personal email, house/listing scans, local events, civic-campaign posts, personal-brain captures) are intentionally excluded - this is the work-and-system list.

Status pills: Enabled runs on schedule; Disabled exists but is paused.

Daily

TaskWhenWhat it doesStatus
Brain auto-tidy3:00 AM dailyDrains the Inbox and files/links notes in both the Work Brain and My Brain per each brain's maintenance rules; Sunday adds an orphan sweep, the 1st adds a monthly prune. AI-system infrastructure.Enabled
Truncation daily scan4:00 PM Mon-FriScans the entire Claude workspace for files clipped mid-write (mid-word tails, missing closers, NUL padding); auto-fixes safe cases, reports the rest, writes a dated HTML report.Enabled
Evening meeting recap4:00 PM Mon-FriDrafts Salesforce case comments for the day's completed customer meetings (Chris, Tyler, Adam) and posts to #meeting-comments.Enabled
Morning meeting summary4:39 PM Sun-ThuPreviews tomorrow's meetings (customer + internal/vendor) per person to #daily-support-call-summary, with Calendly reason + prior-session recap.Enabled
Work PA morning briefing8:00 AM Mon-FriDaily briefing: ingests 5 recurring meetings + support calibration, writes project state to the D1 tracker, rebuilds the briefing artifact.Disabled

Weekly

TaskWhenWhat it doesStatus
System Monitor health checkMon 8:00 AMAutomated health check of the whole School Tech AI ecosystem; posts a structured report to Slack.Enabled
R&D time trackingMon 8:00 AMPulls the prior week's 3 product-dev meetings, updates per-meeting Word notes + the Excel R&D credit tracker (with Stage column).Enabled
Knowledge base update checkerMon 9:09 AMReports overdue KB topics in chat + to #kb-update-check; folds in the semi-annual health-insurance live-figure check when due.Enabled
Skill-backup safety netSun 8:09 AMScans installed custom skills vs the Backups folder and creates/refreshes any missing or stale backup (folder + .skill + CHANGELOG + INDEX). Catches skills built outside an Architect session.Enabled

Slack decisions to STA brainSat 11:06 AMScans active STA Slack threads, extracts durable work decisions into the Work Brain Inbox (routine chatter stays out).Disabled

Maintaining these tasksScheduled tasks are Cowork-only. When creating or editing one that touches project files, the folder field must be set to the workspace folder (...\STA Projects\The Architect) - an empty folder field launches the run with nothing mounted and it fails with "files inaccessible." Architect-produced recurring outputs are created and updated by The Architect; project-specific tasks are owned by their project's Cowork chat; system-wide jobs by System Monitor.
